_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05. Do NOT edit seed.json. Specs from Bugaboo's official Kangaroo spec page. IMPORTANT: despite the sourcing brief's framing, the Kangaroo is NOT a compact stroller — it is an all-terrain single-to-double convertible/tandem. Sourced on its own merits.
name: Bugaboo Kangaroo

clekListed.clekRow: Bugaboo | Kangaroo | Bugaboo Kangaroo Car Seat Adapters | 441200MC01

specs._weightNote: Bugaboo lists 36.5 lb (16.6 kg) with two seats; 37.9 lb (17.2 kg) with bassinet below; ~41.8 lb with bassinet above.
specs._unfoldedNote: In-use length is configuration-dependent: 45.2 in (two seats), 47.2 in (bassinet below), 51.1 in (bassinet above); width 24.4 in throughout. In-use HEIGHT is not published on Bugaboo's spec page (null).
specs._foldedNote: One-piece fold with two seats 31.1 x 24.4 x 33.8 in. One-piece fold with a single seat/bassinet ~19.6 x 24.4 x 38.1 in per retailer specs.

brake.type: foot-operated parking brake (specific mechanism not detailed on Bugaboo spec page)

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (0 mo) — usable with bassinet from birth; converts single-to-double, to ~4 yrs per seat

specs._capacityNote: Main seat max 50 lb (22.7 kg); sibling seat max 40 lb (18.1 kg); bassinet max 20 lb (9 kg). Max child height not published. XL underseat basket 28.6 lb (13 kg) / 70 L.

safety.standards: Not published on Bugaboo's Kangaroo spec page. Sold in the US, so it must meet the mandatory federal stroller standard 16 CFR 1227 (incorporates ASTM F833) to be marketed; EU units carry EN 1888. No explicit standard printed by the manufacturer, so not asserted as certified.
safety.certifications: No JPMA or Greenguard certification published for the Kangaroo on the manufacturer or retailer pages reviewed.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; reversible reclinable seats with adjustable footrest; extendable UPF 50+ canopy; supports up to three kids across seat/sibling-seat/ride-on configurations. Adapter-mounted infant car seats limited to 28.7 lb child weight.

recall.source: CPSC/SaferProducts + Bugaboo product-recalls page; no recall listed for the Bugaboo Kangaroo

specs.foldType: one-piece fold (folds with a single seat/bassinet or with both seats attached)
specs.recline: multi-position reclinable seats (both facing directions); bassinet gives full lie-flat for newborns
specs.tires: extra-large puncture-proof wheels; front ~8.5 in, rear ~12 in; front swivel (all-terrain)

notes: Distinct model; Clek's list files it under 'Bugaboo Kangaroo Car Seat Adapters' part 441200MC01 (same Fox/Lynx/Buffalo/Kangaroo Maxi-Cosi adapter) — adapter-441200mc01. CITY-GOAL FIT CAVEAT: the brief framed the Kangaroo as a compact/foldable stroller, but Bugaboo's own specs show it is the OPPOSITE — a heavy (~36.5-41.8 lb) full-size all-terrain single-to-double convertible/tandem, ~45-51 in long in use. It is the least city/travel-friendly of the three and does not meet a compact-city goal; it fits a growing-family / two-child use case instead. In-use height is not published (null). Best cited price $1,099 (Little Sprout USA, in stock) vs $1,648 DTC MSRP. Clek Liing mounts via the Maxi-Cosi-footprint adapter.
